require 'openssl'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'logger'

module FileVault
  class EncryptionService
    ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-cbc'
    BLOCK_SIZE = 16

    def initialize(master_key_hex, audit_log_path: '/var/log/filevault/audit.log')
      @master_key = [master_key_hex].pack('H*')
      @logger = Logger.new(audit_log_path)
      @iv_registry = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def encrypt_file(file_path, user_id:, session_id:)
      validate_path!(file_path)
      plaintext = File.binread(file_path)
      
      encryption_context = build_context(user_id, session_id, file_path)
      derived_key = derive_file_key(encryption_context)
      iv = generate_iv(encryption_context)
      
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = derived_key
      cipher.iv = iv
      
      ciphertext = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      
      record = {
        ciphertext: ciphertext,
        iv: iv,
        context: encryption_context,
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        checksum: compute_checksum(plaintext)
      }
      
      audit_encryption(user_id, file_path, iv)
      record
    end

    def decrypt_file(record, user_id:, session_id:)
      encryption_context = record[:context]
      derived_key = derive_file_key(encryption_context)
      
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.key = derived_key
      cipher.iv = record[:iv]
      
      plaintext = cipher.update(record[:ciphertext]) + cipher.final
      
      unless compute_checksum(plaintext) == record[:checksum]
        raise SecurityError, "Integrity check failed"
      end
      
      audit_decryption(user_id, record[:context][:file_path])
      plaintext
    end

    private

    def validate_path!(file_path)
      real_path = File.realpath(file_path)
      allowed_base = File.realpath('/data/uploads')
      unless real_path.start_with?(allowed_base + '/')
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected: #{file_path}"
      end
    end

    def build_context(user_id, session_id, file_path)
      {
        user_id: user_id.to_s,
        session_id: session_id.to_s,
        file_path: file_path,
        namespace: resolve_namespace(user_id)
      }
    end

    def resolve_namespace(user_id)
      # Namespace isolation per user tenant
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("tenant:#{user_id}")[0..15]
    end

    def derive_file_key(context)
      # HKDF-like key derivation using context binding.
      # Bind the per-file context (user_id + file_path) into the salt so that
      # each file for each user derives a distinct key, not just per-tenant.
      info = "#{context[:user_id]}:#{context[:file_path]}"
      salt = Digest::SHA256.digest("#{context[:namespace]}|#{info}")
      OpenSSL::PKCS5.pbkdf2_hmac(
        @master_key,
        salt,
        10000,
        32,
        OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new
      )
    end

    def generate_iv(context)
      # Unique IV generation with entropy for each encryption operation
      # Incorporates randomness to ensure uniqueness even for same file
      nonce = SecureRandom.random_bytes(BLOCK_SIZE)
      iv_input = canonical_context(context) + nonce.unpack1('H*')
      hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(
        OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new,
        @master_key,
        iv_input
      )
      hmac[0, BLOCK_SIZE]
    end

    def canonical_context(context)
      # Canonical serialization for IV derivation
      "#{context[:namespace]}|#{context[:user_id]}|#{context[:file_path]}"
    end

    def compute_checksum(data)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data)
    end

    def audit_encryption(user_id, file_path, iv)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        iv_hex = iv.unpack1('H*')
        @logger.info(JSON.generate({
          event: 'file_encrypted',
          user_id: user_id,
          file_path: File.basename(file_path),
          iv_prefix: iv_hex[0..7],
          timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601
        }))
      end
    end

    def audit_decryption(user_id, file_path)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @logger.info(JSON.generate({
          event: 'file_decrypted',
          user_id: user_id,
          file_path: File.basename(file_path),
          timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601
        }))
      end
    end
  end

  class BatchProcessor
    def initialize(service)
      @service = service
    end

    def process_upload(files, user_id:, session_id:)
      results = []
      files.each do |file_path|
        result = @service.encrypt_file(file_path, user_id: user_id, session_id: session_id)
        results << { path: file_path, record: result }
      end
      results
    end

    def process_versioned_upload(file_path, version:, user_id:, session_id:)
      # Re-encrypt same file for new version - each version gets unique IV
      @service.encrypt_file(file_path, user_id: user_id, session_id: session_id)
    end
  end
end
